component.title: Combobox
component.purpose: A searchable selection surface whose local and remote paths share one keyboard, focus, error, and responsive grammar.

states.description: A selected team remains visible while the user can reopen and search the option set.
A new value can be created without losing the query or keyboard flow.
No local result is communicated as a useful empty state.
The error is associated with the combobox and announced.
Remote loading delegates cancellation and retry behavior to AsyncOptionsField.

claims.statement: Local filtering, Arrow/Home/End movement, Escape dismissal, and Enter selection use a native combobox/listbox contract.
Validation errors are linked to the input and exposed through an alert without changing the entered query.
Remote option loading reuses the version-pinned async-options cancellation, debounce, pagination, and retry engine.
Long labels, descriptions, and creation affordances wrap without horizontal overflow on narrow screens.
